name: Brands
descr: The brands of the goods and the options hung on them. The option tree - brand_key with the values of brand_key_value - belongs to the program and is only read here; the brand rows and the rows of brand_key_set are what this tool writes. A goods wears a brand by its brand_id column, and the Price tool writes it.

commands.name: CmdListCut
commands.descr: Reads the brands and nothing beside them. The rows of brand_key_set standing on them come with CmdListFull.

commands.name: CmdListFull
commands.descr: Reads the brands together with the rows of brand_key_set standing on them - two tables in one answer.

commands.name: CmdAdd
commands.descr: Adds a brand at the end of the list.

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key of the brand

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the brand

params.name: descr
params.descr: the description of the brand

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of BRAND_KIND_KEY

params.name: params
params.descr: the additional parameters of the brand, as the program keeps them

params.name: seo_code
params.descr: the SEO parameters of the brand

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list; left out, it goes to the end

commands.name: CmdUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of brands, by id - what the call leaves out stays as it was.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the brand, or several of them

params.name: skey
params.descr: the character key of the brand

params.name: name
params.descr: the name of the brand

params.name: descr
params.descr: the description of the brand

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: a value of BRAND_KIND_KEY

params.name: params
params.descr: the additional parameters of the brand, as the program keeps them

params.name: seo_code
params.descr: the SEO parameters of the brand

params.name: pos
params.descr: the place in the list

commands.name: CmdRemove
commands.descr: Deletes brands by id. The first call counts the goods wearing them, the second one does it: the goods stay in the store with an emptied brand_id, and what hung on the brands - the option rows and the file rows - is swept by the map of the engine.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the brand, or several of them

params.name: depend
params.descr: true - the rows of the tables hanging on these go with them; without it such a deletion is refused

params.name: relation
params.descr: true - the references pointing at these rows are emptied as well; left out, they stay as they are

commands.name: CmdPos
commands.descr: Lays the list of the brands in order.

params.name: type
params.descr: POS - the rows given go to the front in that order; MOVE - one row shifts by so many places, minus upwards; SORT - the whole list is laid out by a column

params.name: data
params.descr: the payload of that type: [{"id": 22}] for POS, [{"id": 22, "inc": -5}] for MOVE - inc is how many places it shifts, minus upwards - and {"field": "name", "direction": "ASC"} for SORT

commands.name: CmdKeyAdd
commands.descr: Sets an option on brands: one row of brand_key_set on each of them. The option and its value must stand in the tree of the brand options, and a stray id is refused.

params.name: brand_id
params.descr: id of the brand, or several of them

params.name: key_id
params.descr: id of the option - the brand_key table of CmdList answers them

params.name: value_id
params.descr: id of the value of that option, when it keeps a list of them - brand_key_value of CmdList

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the text of the value, when the option keeps its own words

commands.name: CmdKeyUpdate
commands.descr: Changes the columns given of the rows of brand_key_set, by id - CmdList answers them with their ids. A row keeps whatever the call leaves out, and the pair it will stand with is weighed against the tree.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the row of brand_key_set, or several of them

params.name: key_id
params.descr: id of the option - the brand_key table of CmdList answers them

params.name: value_id
params.descr: id of the value of that option, when it keeps a list of them - brand_key_value of CmdList

params.name: value_txt
params.descr: the text of the value, when the option keeps its own words

commands.name: CmdKeyRemove
commands.descr: Deletes the rows of brand_key_set by id. The option itself stays in the tree.

params.name: id
params.descr: id of the row of brand_key_set, or several of them
